newsitem.title: USA: BEFORE THE BELL - Dell in earnings rally.
newsitem.headline: BEFORE THE BELL - Dell in earnings rally.

text.p: Shares in Dell Computer Corp gained new ground in pre-open trading on Wednesday, a day after the company reported third quarter earnings that were sharply higher than Wall Street forecasts.
Dell shares surged 3-3/8 to 92, traders said, with about half the rise registered in after-hours activity Tuesday.
Excluding a $0.04 per share charge, Dell earned $1.56 per share for the quarter, trouncing the $1.16 per share consensus estimate reported by First Call.
Traders said personal computer maker Gateway 2000 Inc was also bid higher in pre-open activity.
